beats.name: HOOK
beats.vo: تدري ليش ستوبك يطق من القاع… بعدين السعر يروح حق هدفك؟

text.raw: ستوبك يطق من القاع | in: 0.3s, mask-wipe R→L | Tajawal Bold 92px | #F2F5F7 | lower-third

beats.shot: XAUUSD 15m real TradingView. Price already dropping toward a red stop line sitting under a recent low in the upper-third; last 3 candles printing live. #1 read = the stop line at the low.
beats.cam: push-in 4% / 2.4s / ease-out, centred on the stop line
beats.sfx: sub-drop 40Hz -6dB @0.0 · tick -18dB per printing candle · air bed -30dB
beats.risk: 0-3s exit. Answered by motion in frame 0 plus the stop line under the low as an unresolved threat.

beats.name: PARADOX
beats.vo: القاع اللي تحسه أمان… اهو أول سيولة يسحبونها

text.raw: القاع اللي تحسه أمان = فخ | in: 0.2s, rise 18px | Tajawal Bold 72px | #C9D1D6 | lower-third

beats.shot: Same frame. A wick spikes down through the low, sweeps the stop line, then price snaps back up.
beats.risk: "already know this" exit. Answered by showing the sweep-and-snap-back in one frame.

beats.name: PIVOT

text.raw: شلون؟ | in: 0.1s, stamp | Tajawal Bold 120px | #D6A94A | centred

beats.shot: Chart dims to 45% brightness; the low and the stop line stay lit.
beats.grade: accent gold isolated on the text only
beats.risk: none — this beat exists to reset attention.

beats.name: INVITE
beats.shot: Chart back to full brightness; two lows get circled — one labelled ضعيف, one قوي.
beats.cam: pull-back 6% / 1.2s / ease-in-out to reveal both lows
beats.risk: 6s promise-without-proof drop. Answered by the two labelled lows landing now.

beats.name: BELIEF+WHY
beats.vo: القاع القوي اهو اللي بعده كسر هاي قديم… حط ستوبك تحته

text.raw: القاع القوي = بعد كسر هاي | in: 1.4s, scale-in | Tajawal Bold 100px | #D6A94A | centred

beats.shot: Zoom to the strong low: price makes the low, then rallies and breaks an old high (marked with a dashed line). An arrow drops the stop under that low.
beats.cam: push-in 6% / 2.2s / ease-out on the strong low
beats.grade: gold accent +8% on the broken-high line only
beats.sfx: tick -20dB @7.4 as the stop line locks under the low
beats.risk: mid-video sag. Answered by the rule landing as a visual event, not a claim.

beats.name: TURN
beats.vo: لكن باقي القيعان؟ سيولة… يسحبونها ويطق ستوبك

text.raw: القاع الضعيف = سيولة | in: 0.8s, mask-wipe R→L | Tajawal Bold 88px | #EF5350 | lower-third

beats.shot: The weak low's label flips from ضعيف to سيولة; a liquidity arrow points into it and a wick sweeps through.
beats.grade: red accent permitted on the label only
beats.risk: disbelief. Answered by the sweep being shown, not claimed.

beats.name: VERDICT
beats.vo: عشان جذي ستوبك يطق من القاع

text.raw: ستوبك يطق من القاع | in: 0.05s, stamp | Tajawal Bold 96px | #F2F5F7 | centred

beats.shot: The sweep candle spikes through the weak low in slow motion; the wick closes back above it.
beats.cam: shake 1.5px @ 3Hz for 0.4s on the outer frame only

beats.name: PROOF
beats.vo: شوف: القاع الضعيف يسحبونه… والقاع القوي يصمد

text.content: قاع ضعيف ← يُسحب · قاع قوي ← يصمد
text.raw: قاع ضعيف ← يُسحب · قاع قوي ← يصمد | in: 0.4s, rise 18px | Tajawal Bold 74px | #C9D1D6 | lower-third

beats.shot: Pull back to show both lows side by side: the weak low gets swept, the strong low (after the broken high) holds and price runs up.
beats.risk: post-peak drop-off. Answered by this being the longest held shot — the breath.

beats.name: CARE
beats.vo: الستوب مكانه وين الفكرة تفشل… مو وين المخاطرة أقل

text.raw: الستوب = وين الفكرة تفشل | in: 0.3s, mask-wipe R→L | Tajawal Bold 84px | #2E9E8F | lower-third

beats.shot: The stop line animates from under the weak low up to under the strong low.
beats.cam: track up 90px / 1.4s / ease-in-out following the line

beats.name: LOOP
beats.vo: بس شلون تعرف القاع قوي قبل لا تدخل؟ اكتب «قاع» بالتعليقات ويوصلك الملف كامل

text.raw: اكتب «قاع» بالتعليقات | in: 0.6s, rise 18px | Tajawal Bold 80px | #D6A94A | lower-third

beats.shot: Return to the frame-0 composition — same chart region, candles printing again, stop line under the low.
beats.cut: hard out — final frame equals frame 0 for a seamless replay
beats.risk: exit before the CTA. Answered by placing the CTA at 88% and seaming the loop.
